42.name: Poacher
42.description: This player has one objective: score goals. They stay forward and focus on making runs in behind the defence, hoping to fashion a chance to score.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: With an Attack focus, the Poacher will lurk just off the defensive line, ready to capitalise on any defensive gaps or errors.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: When set to Support, the Poacher will stay close to the opposition defence, aggressively pressing them when in possession, in the hope of triggering a mistake.

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: With a Versatile focus, the Poacher will use their judgement to determine if they should come back to support their team or apply pressure.

26.name: Inside Forward
26.description: A wide attacker who begins on the wing, but will regularly cut inside onto their preferred foot to shoot or play the final pass. They tend to run in behind the defence.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Inside Forward will offer minimal defensive support, and sometimes hold off making runs in behind to instead offer passing options.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When given an Attack focus, the Inside Forward will focus on cutting inside and making attacking runs.

15.name: Centre-Half
15.description: A defensive midfielder that will drop between the centre-backs while their team is in possession to offer protection against the counterattack.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When set to Defend, the Centre-Half will focus on their defensive duties.

4.name: Falseback
4.description: A modern evolution of the fullback, this player pushes up the field, adopting a central position, when their team has the ball.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When set to Balanced, the Falseback positions themselves as a Central Midfielder when their team is in possession.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When set to Defend, the Falseback operates as a Defensive Midfielder when the team has the ball.

48.name: Wide Back
48.description: A central defender who opens wide to cover for the fullbacks. Usually deployed on 3-back formations.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: With a Defend focus, the Wide Back will cover for the fullbacks in all phases but stay close to the defensive line.

focuses.name: Aggressive
focuses.description: With an Aggressive focus, the Wide Back will also close down opponents and intercept passes during the defensive phase.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: With a Support focus, the Wide Back will move up the side of the pitch to a pass option when their team needs to release pressure.

35.name: Winger
35.description: A wide midfielder who will always stay wide, hugging the touchline, and offering support on the flanks in all phases of play.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Winger will offer both defensive and attacking support. They mix making runs in behind and offering themselves as a passing option.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When set to Attack, the Winger will focus on getting forward, and prefers to make runs behind the defence instead of receiving the ball to feet.

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: The Versatile Winger decides when it's the right opportunity to attack or defend, and they can swap sides with another Versatile Winger between phases of play.

30.name: Inside Forward
30.description: A wide attacker who begins on the wing, but will regularly cut inside onto their preferred foot to shoot or play the final pass. They tend to run in behind the defence.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Inside Forward will offer minimal defensive support, and sometimes hold off making runs in behind to instead offer passing options.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When given an Attack focus, the Inside Forward will focus on cutting inside and making attacking runs.

46.name: Inverted Wingback
46.description: A modern attacking Fullback who gets forward and adopts a central position high up the pitch when their team has the ball.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When asked to Build-Up, the Inverted Wingback will act as a central Playmaker, helping dictate the play.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When asked to Attack, the Inverted Wingback will act as a central Shadow Striker, helping in the final third.

25.name: Wide Playmaker
25.description: A creative outlet positioned out wide, but able to move inside to help create chances to unpick defences.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: With an Attack focus, the Wide Playmaker will move forward, and receive passes out wide.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When set to Build-Up, the Wide Playmaker will come short to offer a passing option, while balancing their approach to support the defence if needed.

9.name: Wingback
9.description: This player's versatility and stamina allows them to push upfield to support attacks, before returning to their defensive position.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: With Balanced, the Wingback is given license to stay forward even when the team is out of possession, or drop back into defence when needed.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: When asked to Support, the Wingback can only attack when their team has controlled possession, and only defend when the team doesn't have the ball.

20.name: Deep-Lying Playmaker
20.description: The key cog to building up play from the back, this defensively positioned midfielder will often be the catalyst for attacks.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: With a Defend focus, the Deep-Lying Playmaker will focus on closing down passing lanes and staying back while their team attacks.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When set to Build-Up, the Deep-Lying Playmaker will move forward and offer a passing option to support attacks.

23.name: Winger
23.description: A wide midfielder who will always stay wide, hugging the touchline, and offering support on the flanks in all phases of play.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Winger will offer both defensive and attacking support. They mix making runs in behind and offering themselves as a passing option.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When set to Attack, the Winger will focus on getting forward, and prefers to make runs behind the defence instead of receiving the ball to feet.

6.name: Attacking Wingback
6.description: Though technically a defender, this player will be more concerned with getting forward, and offering width to their team's attacks.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: When asked to Support, the Attacking Wingback will rarely sprint back to defend, unless their team has been hit on the counter.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When asked to Attack, the Attacking Wingback will push even higher up the pitch, and perform fewer defensive duties.

45.name: Ball-Playing Keeper
45.description: A modern ball-playing goalkeeper who supports build-up play as a passing option and stays on their line when their team is in defense.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: A Build-Up focus encourages the Ball-Playing Keeper to push higher up the pitch to support play.

32.name: Shadow Striker
32.description: An attack-minded midfielder who plays in the 'hole' behind the strikers. Their well-timed runs into the box will result in plenty of goal-scoring opportunities.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When set to Attack, the Shadow Striker will focus on making late runs into the box, filling the space behind the striker.

7.name: Fullback
7.description: A wide defender that will prioritise protecting their own goal, by staying back, holding the defensive line, and offering a passing option to release pressure.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When set to Balanced, the Fullback is granted more freedom to push slightly forward and wider in support of attacks.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When set to Defend, the Fullback will move inside to form a back three when their team is in possession.

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: When set to Versatile, the Fullback can move inside to form a back three or push slightly forward and wider to support build-up.

49.name: Box Crasher
49.description: A defensive midfielder who can get forward to join the attack, making trailing runs into the box, if the opportunity arises.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When asked to be Balanced, the Box Crasher will balance their responsibilities between defence and offence.

17.name: Wide Half
17.description: A defensive midfielder charged with marking and covering the sides of the pitch when needed.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When instructed to Defend, the Wide Half can drop into the Fullback and Wingback positions while their team has the ball.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When set to Build-Up, the Wide Half can move wide into the Wingback position, and forward into Wide Midfielder territory, when their team is in possession.

34.name: Classic 10
34.description: A traditional attacking midfielder, through whom most creative and attacking play will go through.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When asked to Attack, the Classic 10 will maintain their position in the pocket behind the forward line, operating as the team's chief creative force.

focuses.name: Wide
focuses.description: When set to Wide, the Classic 10 is able to drift out to the wing and dictate attacks from anywhere across the width of the pitch.

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: When set to Versatile, the Classic 10 will use their best judgement when determining if they should stay central or use the pitch's width during attacks.

28.name: Wide Midfielder
28.description: A midfielder who stays wide to facilitate play, providing passing and defensive support, but rarely ventures forward to attack.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: When in a Support focus, the Wide Midfielder will stay wide to support possession and provide defensive support when needed.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When asked to Defend, the Wide Midfielder will drop into the defensive midfield line and protect the defence.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When in Build-Up, the Wide Midfielder will position themselves a little higher up the pitch to support plays, while providing defensive support if needed.

12.name: Stopper
12.description: A ball-winning centre-back who will step forward from the defensive line to make tackles, intercept passes, and lead the press.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: With a Balanced focus, the Stopper will intercept passes and pressure attackers receiving the ball.

focuses.name: Aggressive
focuses.description: When asked to be Aggressive, the Stopper will push up into the base of midfield to intercept passes and close down attackers.

47.name: Inverted Wingback
47.description: A modern attacking Fullback who gets forward and adopts a central position high up the pitch when their team has the ball.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: When asked to Build-Up, the Inverted Wingback will act as a central Playmaker, helping dictate the play.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When asked to Attack, the Inverted Wingback will act as a central Shadow Striker, helping in the final third.

19.name: Holding
19.description: A pivotal role in modern football, this defence-minded midfielder focuses on guarding their backline during attacks, and covering off against counter-attacks, with limited attacking support.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When instructed to Defend, the Holding Midfielder will move slightly higher to offer a passing option, but will otherwise focus on defending.

focuses.name: Ball-Winning
focuses.description: The Ball-Winning focus tasks the Holding Midfielder with aggressively intercepting passing as part of their defensive focus.

18.name: Box-to-Box
18.description: This player operates between the two boxes, operating as neither the last line of defence, nor the final part of attack, but involved in everything in between.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When asked to be Balanced, the Box-to-Box Midfielder will cover the centre of the pitch in attack and defence.

focuses.name: Ball-Winning
focuses.description: When asked to be Ball-Winning, the Box-to-Box Midfielder will focus on recovering the ball while providing central support in attack and defence.

33.name: Half-Winger
33.description: A midfielder who provides width when their team is in possession, moving along the flanks to offer a wide threat. Particularly effective when one of three central midfielders.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Half-Winger will alternate equally between attacking and defending in a measured way.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When set to Attack, the Half-Winger can advance freely, sacrificing defensive responsibilities.

focuses.name: Roaming
focuses.description: When set to Roaming, this attacking Half-Winger will freely alternate the side on which they attack, even during plays.

41.name: Advanced Forward
41.description: A versatile attacker who usually stays close to the opposition's defensive line, but opens themselves up for passes in the build-up, and makes a run in behind for scoring chances.

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: With an Attack focus, the Advanced Forward will concentre on goal-scoring opportunities, usually positioning themselves high and central on the pitch.

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: When set to Support, the Advanced Forward will look to make runs from deeper or wider positions, and press the defenders.

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: When set to Versatile, the Advanced Forward has the freedom to move wide when necessary to receive a pass or create space with a run.

31.name: Playmaker
31.description: This player tends to be the creative fulcrum of a midfield, given license to roam and create space and opportunities for attacks. Likely to be out of position if the opposition counters.

focuses.name: Roaming
focuses.description: When set to Roaming, the Playmaker will have freedom to explore the pitch to find the best spaces to support attacks.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When asked to be Balanced, the Playmaker will offer defensive support when needed, as well as orchestrating attacks.

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: With Build-Up, the Playmaker is asked to drop deeper to get the ball, and orchestrate an attack.

44.name: Target Forward
44.description: An attacking outlet whose physicality allows them to hold up play, shielding the ball from opponents, and bringing others into attacks. They feed on crosses as well as passes to feet.

focuses.description: With an Attack focus, the Target Forward is free to focus on going forward, without any defensive instructions.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: When Balanced, the Target Forward will drop off from the defensive line, hold up play, and lay the ball off to teammates. They will have minor defensive duties.

focuses.name: Wide
focuses.description: When set to Wide, the Target Forward will drift to the edges of the box in a search for space to make an impact.

11.name: Defender
11.description: A no-nonsense centre-back who excels at the basics of defending, including maintaining the defensive line.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: When asked to Defend, the Defender will focus only on their defensive responsibilities.

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: With a Balanced focus, the Defender will step up to close down attackers when needed.

focuses.description: A Balanced focus allows the Sweeper Keeper to leave their area to collect balls close to their box.

focuses.name: Build-Up

focuses.description: With a Balanced focus, the Goalkeeper will occasionally leave their area to collect long or loose balls.

focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: With a Defend focus, the Goalkeeper won't rush out to collect long or loose balls.

focuses.name: Build-Up

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: When set to Attack, the False 9 will drop back from the opposition's defence, and make trailing runs into the box from deep.
